eligibility_summary: Applicants for, and holders of, British Academy awards at any career stage who have additional needs that their host university or research organisation cannot meet — for example equipment to overcome barriers for disabled researchers, support for sensory impairment, caring costs while researching away from home, or mental health support while making an application.

Applicants are advised to apply at least two months before the closing date of the call the support relates to.
